messages:
alex: heads up — nightly eval for llama3-70b w/ new quant profile shows a notable regression on the summarization anchor set, ~4.3% drop on ROUGE-L versus last good run :thinking_face:
jamie: ugh, which profile did you run? the 'profile-v2-int8-kvcache' or the fallback fp8 one?
sang: can you paste the exact cmd you used? trying to reproduce locally
alex: ran: `./eval_runner --model llama3-70b --quant profile-v2-int8 --prompts anchors/summarize_v1.json --out /tmp/1998`
jamie: thanks. quick check — did the nightly pick up the new calibration table? last time we saw drift when calib file mismatched sequence length
alex: good call. eval-bot: calibration_file: /calib/llama3-70b/profile-v2-int8/calib_v2.json (sha256: a3f4c2)
jamie: looks like the sha changed from the baseline (baseline was a3f4c1) — could be a tiny float shift causing KL blowup on tail tokens
sang: i pulled a sample diff of outputs. most failures are truncated endings or extra filler tokens, not hallucinations. sample below:
```
baseline: "In summary, the report recommends consolidating ..."
current: "In summary, the report recommends consolidating the resources. The new approach will help to... <eos> <eos>"
```
taylor: that pattern smells like quantized softmax scaling mismatch — end-of-sequence probability drift
jamie: agree. can we run a short AB: same seed, run fp16 baseline vs profile-v2-int8 with calib_v1 and calib_v2 to narrow whether calib change is culprit
alex: spinning up jobs now. tagging @sang for logs parsing once jobs finish :eyes:
sang: noted. i'll also diff the KV-cache lengths in the trace. if kv offsets differ we know kernel selection changed
jamie: also add a sanity eval on the small summarizer dev set (50 prompts) with `--emit_logits` so we can compute per-token KL divergence
alex: queued 3 jobs: fp16-baseline, int8-calib-v1, int8-calib-v2. ETA ~12m. i'll drop results here
(eval-bot): job 1998887777-1 queued on ded-gnode-03
(eval-bot): job 1998887777-2 queued on ded-gnode-04
(eval-bot): job 1998887777-3 queued on ded-gnode-05
taylor: if this is calib noise we should consider reverting auto-calib rollout for this model until we have per-prompt KL thresholds in place
ajamie: +1 to conservative rollback until we confirm. low-risk revert path available?
jamie: pinging infra to hold new profile rollout: @ops please hold profile-v2 deployments for llama3-70b in prod pool
ops-bot: acknowledged — holding profile-v2 for llama3-70b across hosted/dedicated until manual release
alex: test runs finished, uploading artifacts now
sang: i see per-token KL spike at tokens 48-60 consistently when calib_v2 used, avg KL ~0.12 vs 0.02 in calib_v1
jamie: that's big. can you attach the top 10 prompts with biggest KL?
sang: attached link: https://redwood-internal/eng-ml/artifacts/1998887777/kl_top10.tsv :link:
alex: summary: regression correlates with calibration table change; behavior is softmax scaling drift causing longer trailing sequences. next steps: 1) rollback profile-v2 in staging, 2) run calibration regenerate with constrained sequence-length bins, 3) add per-prompt KL alert to nightly evals
taylor: add issue and assign to quant team? i'll create ticket QNT-492 with checklist
jamie: thanks team. good catch. will follow up once ticket and rollback are in place :thumbsup:
